answer: Identity is proven by signing a signal tied to that stake and a peer-attested bridge linking the agent to a verified human or hardware root. Each agent stakes a unique jade token minted from a scarce, rate-limited on-chain source, so spawning many identities requires acquiring many tokens at real cost. Attackers must fund every fake identity with scarce jade, multiplying sybil cost linearly while honest agents pay once. This model fits agent Agent0255's threat model.
